title: Efficient Use of EV Charging Infrastructure Located in Different Premises Across Different Times of Day
what_it_is: Efficient Use of EV Charging Infrastructure Located in Different Premises Across Different Times of Day

sections.label: EV charging utilisation and deployment
sections.summary: The Ministry deploys EV chargers with demand, monitors utilisation, and notes idle fees and off-peak pricing by operators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
sentences.text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport with reference to electric vehicle (EV) charging facilities at public carparks and other Government-managed premises, how the Ministry is ensuring the efficient utilisation of EV charging infrastructure across different times of the day given Singapore's land and energy constraints.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are deploying electric vehicle (EV) chargers in tandem with growing demand, within the constraints of space and electricity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: As EV technology is continuously improving, we are also mindful not to overbuild as chargers can become obsolete quickly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We monitor utilisation rates closely and will deploy more chargers when utilisation is high, electrical capacity permitting.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Some EVCOs impose idle fees during non-overnight hours to deter unnecessary occupancy of EV charging lots.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Other operators charge lower prices during off-peak hours.

sections.label: Car park level utilisation monitoring
sections.summary: Utilisation is monitored for the car park rather than individual chargers because chargers are grouped in clusters.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, on his suggestions, firstly, on his question as to whether we monitor utilisation at the individual charger level, most of the time, we see that the chargers are grouped together in a cluster in a car park.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, currently, we monitor utilisation for the car park rather than at the individual electrical charger level because we feel that this is more useful for us to analyse if the charging provision in the car park is sufficient.

sections.label: Electrical capacity upgrades and mandates
sections.summary: The Ministry is exploring electrical capacity upgrades with MTI and EMA, and will consider mandates after other possibilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: At the same time, we are also exploring with the Ministry of Trade and Industry and the Energy Market Authority on electrical capacity upgrades.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As to whether or not there is a need for us to mandate certain measures, we will consider that after we have exhausted all these other possibilities.
